description: Defines Kubernetes scheduling priority classes, including PriorityClass and PriorityClassList structures, with associated metadata and policies.

classes.name: PriorityClass
classes.description: Represents a mapping from a priority class name to an integer value, including optional default and preemption policy settings.

classes.name: PriorityClassList
